degree_rationale: Living Spirit's three formative purifying acts (the wheel of stars cast down, sea-prow established with seal of the zodiac, dragon-Error in the sea — depicted as a craftsman casting molds and a coin-stamper). Illumines purification-mechanism through artisan analogy.
direction_rationale: Illumines the Living Spirit's purifying work via vivid artisanal analogies (image-painter, coin-maker). Wisdom showing the work in its splendor.
grand_man_function: Spiritual purifying-illumination — the artisan working cosmic substance.
title: The Living Spirit's purification through three formative acts
